title: Transportation Transformation
summary: In Toronto's West End, Exhibition GO is in the midst of a transformation from a simple side-platform rail station into a major modal hub. Along with new centre platforms and a sweeping, sheltering roof that will greet increased GO train service, Ontario Line 3's initial western terminus is also being constructed along the north side of the station where it will meet an expanding and transit-hungry Liberty Village. Staying open during construction, expanded GO facilities will result before the new subway line begins operating in the early 2030s.
